data.name: Kuzaama
data.gender_notes: Kuzaama is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root k-z-m, meaning to purify or cleanse. In Islamic tradition, this name represents the spiritual journey towards inner and outer purification, and the striving for moral and ethical excellence. The name Kuzaama carries the meaning “To purify, cleanse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kuzaama usually hope their child will grow to embody to purify, cleanse and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: كوزامة

in_hindi.name: कुज़ामह
